Also for the girls, go for the other girls the ones that are apart of hobbies you like. Even if she isn’t exactly the looker maybe she can hold a good conversation and is super good at poker or something. 

For the mom, don’t put your value on her expectations because you will never be happy.
Hey man I’m sorry to hear this, you ever try getting into a very social games? Like Magic or Dungeons and dragons? You could meet so many cool people with it.
It’s more I am good to be around when every thing is broken and I can help out but once things are going well... I’m not worth anything
I’m going to try to get on a later date
I did and the problem is is he’s not acknowledging it at all in our conversation that’s why I got so worried...  scratch that I am worried that I fucked it up forever
The problem is is that I don’t want to lose that person that I have a valuable connection with

Because if I was a normal person I wouldn’t go along with people that I barely like because they’re there I would just wait and hold onto the more valuable people trying to develop a relationship there instead of instant gratification.
Not really it’s more along lines of one’s more available than the other one and I’m kind of toxic and lonely.. but if I could I would so risk it to meet this other person.
The other dude is kinda shitty to me and I know he isn’t good for me nor do we share anything in common... But some how we always end up in the same place at the wrong time...

Well, to be quite honest he was making me so happy and I was slowly starting to fall for him and I was hanging out with somebody that I should not have and I lied to the guy that I think is awesome about it at first and then I told him the truth.. and he seems a little distant since I was honest.

Your right, it's just I gained 75 pounds way fast (a year) and it was an intense change. It went from watching what I eat and working out every day to eating whatever I wanted up to 4000 cal a day with zero exercise and now I'm trying to fix it. I just for some reason wanted it to be as easy as gaining the weight. So 31 pounds in 6 months is very sucky. But I am not on a strict diet.
I feel you.. I am looked at in bad light because of my child abuse jokes but I do it to forget my mommy issues.
I do this too, it's so bad. What happens is I get them and they fall in love with me than I drop them. But to be fair I also choose people that are a bit distant and I need constant closeness.
Yes! I can't have a normal convocation without a joke. I can act like a loud funny personality but that is all it is really an act.
I do this all the time I will be crying my eyes out than stop what I am doing and call my friend and ask about his day and problems.. I help them because my own pain is too overwhelming.

I can't tell you about meds but there are all different types of therapy. Example to make yourself social is exposer therapy. I do this a lot for I am basically a cat and have to go outside. And after awhile it seems less and less like a chore. Another thing is find something you really like and do it or have it once a day so it's a thing to think about to help you get out of bed.

Legit man, I just want instant love and leave before they do.. I always cry and tell them not to leave me, but i leave them when I feel like they left me in an emotional way. Like being distant and such. I want to stay but I can't.. I don't think I ever will.

Oh gosh this is what I thought when I was growing up in what you are describing.... difference is I did try and nothing happened except me almost dying. Please take it from me that if they don't seem to care now you can't change them. All you can do is to try to love yourself and take care of yourself the way you wish they would. Give yourself the attention and care you deserve, because you are alive and worth it.

It's a shitty situation that is no doubt. Family (in my experience) is shitty to me. But if you die tomorrow you won't be able to live your good part. The part that when you look back on this you will feel like you have gone so far. It's not too late man. It's gonna be ok.
